phase.name: source_data_access_and_audit
phase.completion_gate: Exact paper inclusion subset and the 894-to-approximately-863-hour discrepancy must be evidenced; tooling completion is insufficient.

scope.included: Only the published BabyView CLIP+ Machine-DevBench row
excluded: training or data processing during Phase 0

paper.title: EgoBabyVLM: Benchmarking Cross-Modal Learning from Naturalistic Egocentric Video Data

training_data.access: controlled Databrary access; authorization and participant privacy terms required
training_data.redistribution: forbidden for raw and derived sensitive content

phase1_evidence.governed_storage_available_during_audit: yes; all controlled exports and detailed matching outputs remained in owner-only governed storage, although SSH authentication was intermittent
phase1_evidence.current_blocker: Neither public code nor authorized exports identify the exact approximately 863-hour usable subset, its record-level exclusion reasons, or the frozen release/accounting crosswalk needed to reconcile 894 hours with the official candidate mapping.
phase1_evidence.public_code_finding: Pinned code recursively discovers supplied video files and does not publish the exact BabyView inclusion manifest or a release-to-training selection rule.
phase1_evidence.minimum_external_evidence: Author-provided privacy-safe inclusion-manifest digest plus a governed matchable list and record-level exclusion reasons; the frozen 2025.1 Airtable export or authoritative asset rename/supersession crosswalk is also needed to reconcile release accounting.
phase1_evidence.privacy_boundary: Detailed rows, record references, filenames, paths, and hashes remain only in governed storage; Git retains aggregate evidence only.

targets_percent.aggregation: For each run, overall is the unweighted arithmetic mean of lexical and grammatical; report mean and sample standard deviation across the same three seeds.

allowed_training_data: authorized BabyView release 2025.1 inputs and protocol-permitted derivatives only
allowed_evaluation_data: the checksum-verified official Eval-Data MachineDevBench.tar asset only
forbidden: public or web data as scientific-run training data
redistribution of BabyView raw or derived sensitive data
public or web pretrained weights as initialization for any scientific-run learned component
data_and_initialization_policy.preprocessing_models: Only paper-permitted preprocessing use may be considered; it must be pinned and must not initialize the scientific model.

entries.statement: The published overall mean is the equal-weight mean of lexical and grammatical subgroup means.
entries.basis: 53.6 = (53.4 + 53.8) / 2; this must be confirmed against released evaluation aggregation before Phase 4.

entries.statement: No deviation from the frozen target protocol is authorized in Phase 0.
The approximately 31-hour discrepancy remains unexplained; no recording-level inclusion decision may be inferred from the two aggregate duration claims.
entries.basis: The official release and pinned EgoBabyVLM README provide aggregate hours, while the pinned code provides no exact inclusion manifest or deterministic selection rule.

entries.statement: Official BabyView project analyses describe 868 hours of release-2025.1 video, introducing a second accounting figure alongside the reported 894-hour Databrary metadata and EgoBabyVLM's approximately 863 hours.
entries.basis: Official BabyView project CCN 2025 materials state 3,163,675 one-Hz frames and 868 hours from release 2025.1; public sources do not define a record-level mapping among these totals.

entries.statement: The official BabyView mapping resolves the 868-hour figure to 4,610 BV-main recordings totaling 868.4602 hours, strongly supporting BV-main as the EgoBabyVLM source cohort but not proving the exact approximately 863-hour usable subset.
entries.basis: Governed exact matching of the 5,566-entry candidate list to the official mapping resolved 5,498 entries: 4,610 BV-main recordings (868.4602 hours) and 888 legacy single-child recordings (69.6941 hours). Public artifacts contain no record-level usable exclusion manifest.
